critique: The render convincingly captures the Triangles 2D look: crisp flat triangle sprites, black background, mint-to-lime coloring, and clear expansion from the compact t1 cluster into a broad t4 field. At t4 the field is substantially more legible than prior iterations, but the center still contains a small congested knot of overlapping particles. Scale variation is also stronger than the thumbnail-like treatment: a few peripheral triangles are conspicuously larger than the majority, weakening the clean, consistently sized scattered-field impression.

suggestions.why: Reduce particle-size randomness so the large edge outliers better match the more consistently scaled, clean geometric triangle field.
Slightly lower the continuous emission density to reduce the remaining overlapping center knot while retaining a full screen-spanning field.
